buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Preferable manufacturer should participate. Participating traders/agents must provide authorization lett er issued by the OEM. Authorization letter should be tender/Bid specific. Bidders must submit valid authori zation letter containing the required information along with their offer failing which the offer is liable to be ignored. 2. For placement of order, the OEM [Principal Firm] directly or through authorized dealers shall have succe ssfully executed a contract for supply of A4 and Legal Size Multifunction Printer (MFP)to any Govt organizat ion/PSU/PPP Project of minimum 10 percent of the advertised value of the bid [Bid Value – 49631.00] durin g previous 3 years. This period of 3 years shall be counted with respect to date of tender closing. In this re gard, Firms should submit a past performance document in the form of CRN/CRAC/R-NOTE/completion cert ificate issued by competent authority of that Govt organization/PSU/PPP Project along with PO. Failure to s ubmit documentary evidence will imply that firm has no such performance and Railways reserves the right to disqualify the offer. In case tenderer participates as an authorized agent, then the past performance as required above shall be that of the principal, authorizing the agent. It may so happen that the agent has cr edentials of past supply for a different Principal, but these will not be considered as performance for placin g the order in case of change of Principal. 3. At-least one OEM Authorized service center should be located in Nagpur city Complete Address & Phon e numbers of a functional OEM authorized service center in Nagpur city to be provided by the bidder fallin g which the offer is liable to be ignored. 4. Contract shall be governed by IRS conditions. 5. Material Transportation, handling and unloading is in the scope of supplier. .
